description:
Three small test gaps from the review:

1. Queue-full at facade: no test asserts `OctoPi.Agent.steer/2` or
   `follow_up/2` returns `{:error, :full}`. Wire a 1-bounded queue
   via set_queue_mode + bound override (need to expose bound on
   session opts) and fill it.

2. `set_queue_mode(:steering, :all)`: follow_up ':all' is covered;
   steering isn't. Add a symmetric test.

3. Abort during LLM stream: all abort tests currently fire during
   tool sleep. The Producer's caller-dies path (Phase 1 opi-hgb.2)
   should also produce an :aborted AgentEnd when the loop is killed
   mid-stream. Add a FakeTransport that blocks on receive (so the
   loop is stuck in the stream reducer) and assert that
   abort/1 still yields a timely :aborted AgentEnd.

Note for (1): PendingMessageQueue already supports a custom bound,
but Session.init/1 doesn't accept it as an opt. May need a small
plumbing change — call it out in the commit.
title: Fill test gaps: queue-full facade, set_queue_mode :steering, abort-during-stream
